title: HSK 4 Practice: 选词填空, 排列顺序, 阅读理解
description: HSK-4-style practice with this batch: a word bank of connectors, ordering three sentence parts, and short readings.

points.title: 选词填空 (HSK 4)
points.summary: Word bank: 既然, 只要, 千万, 毕竟, 即使, 反而.
points.body:
- 既然 + known fact，就 ….
- 只要 + sufficient condition，就 ….
- 千万 + 别 / 要.
- 毕竟 = after all.
examples: {既然|jìrán}{你|nǐ}{已经|yǐjīng}{来|lái}{了|le}，{就|jiù}{一起|yìqǐ}{吃饭|chīfàn}{吧|ba}。
Since you're here already, let's eat together.

points.title: 排列顺序 (HSK 4)
points.summary: HSK 4 reading part 2: order three parts. Look for pairs (本来…可是…所以, 不但没…反而) and for parts that can't open a text.
points.body:
- 于是, 所以, 可是, 反而 never start the text.
- 从小 / 本来 often set the scene.
examples: {本来|běnlái}{打算|dǎsuàn}{今天|jīntiān}{去|qù}，{可是|kěshì}{下雨|xià yǔ}{了|le}。
I'd planned to go today, but it rained.

points.title: 阅读理解 (HSK 4)
points.summary: Find the sentence with the connector the question hinges on: 由于 / 因此 for reasons, 自从 for changes, 只有…才 for the main message.
points.body: - The 'main idea' question usually matches the 只有…才 / 应该 sentence.
examples: Only once you've been there yourself will you know.

notes: 反而 = 'on the contrary'.
只要 is for a condition, not a known fact.
即使 pairs with 也.
questions.translation: Since you're here already, let's eat together.

notes: 反而 = 'on the contrary'.
毕竟 = 'after all'.
千万 = 'be sure to'.
questions.translation: As long as I have time, I'll come and see you.

questions.prompt: {这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{事|shì}{你|nǐ}（　）{别|bié}{告诉|gàosu}{他|tā}，{他|tā}{会|huì}{生气|shēngqì}{的|de}。
notes: 毕竟 = 'after all'.
即使 needs 也.
反而 = 'on the contrary'.
questions.translation: Whatever you do, don't tell him about this — he'll be angry.

notes: 千万 = 'be sure to'.
只要 = 'as long as'.
反而 = 'on the contrary'.
questions.translation: Don't blame him — it's his first time, after all.

notes: 所以 can't open the text.
The rain (C) is the reason for 所以 — it must come before A.
可是 can't open the text.
questions.translation: We'd planned to go hiking today, but when we got up it was raining, so we decided to go another day.

questions.explanation: **B** 从小… **C** 大学毕业以后，**A** 于是….
notes: 于是 can't open the text.
C + 于是 leaves out who 'he' is — B introduces him.
从小 doesn't fit after 大学毕业以后.
questions.translation: He's been interested in Chinese culture since he was little, so after graduating he decided to study in China.

questions.explanation: **B** → **C** 不但没瘦 → **A** 反而更胖.
notes: 反而 can't open the text.
反而 can't open the text.
可是 can't open the text.
questions.translation: She's on a diet every day, but instead of losing weight she keeps getting heavier.

questions.prompt:
{很|hěn}{多|duō}{人|rén}{以为|yǐwéi}{熊猫|xióngmāo}{只|zhǐ}{吃|chī}{竹子|zhúzi}，{其实|qíshí}{熊猫|xióngmāo}{偶尔|ǒu'ěr}{也|yě}{吃|chī}{肉|ròu}。{不过|búguò}，{由于|yóuyú}{竹子|zhúzi}{到处|dàochù}{都|dōu}{是|shì}，{而且|érqiě}{很|hěn}{容易|róngyì}{得到|dédào}，{因此|yīncǐ}{竹子|zhúzi}{就|jiù}{成|chéng}{了|le}{它们|tāmen}{最|zuì}{主要|zhǔyào}{的|de}{食物|shíwù}。

★ {熊猫|xióngmāo}{为什么|wèishénme}{主要|zhǔyào}{吃|chī}{竹子|zhúzi}？
notes: Taste isn't mentioned.
偶尔也吃肉 — they sometimes eat meat.
That's what many people wrongly think (以为).
questions.translation: Many people think pandas only eat bamboo, but they occasionally eat meat too. Because bamboo is everywhere and easy to get, it became their main food. ★ Why do pandas mainly eat bamboo?

questions.prompt:
{我|wǒ}{本来|běnlái}{不|bù}{喜欢|xǐhuan}{运动|yùndòng}，{可是|kěshì}{自从|zìcóng}{去年|qùnián}{开始|kāishǐ}{跑步|pǎobù}{以后|yǐhòu}，{我|wǒ}{发现|fāxiàn}{自己|zìjǐ}{的|de}{身体|shēntǐ}{越来越|yuè lái yuè}{好|hǎo}，{心情|xīnqíng}{也|yě}{好|hǎo}{多|duō}{了|le}。{现在|xiànzài}，{即使|jíshǐ}{工作|gōngzuò}{再|zài}{忙|máng}，{我|wǒ}{也|yě}{会|huì}{每天|měitiān}{跑|pǎo}{半|bàn}{个|ge}{小时|xiǎoshí}。

★ {关于|guānyú}“{我|wǒ}”，{可以|kěyǐ}{知道|zhīdào}：
notes: 即使工作再忙 implies work is busy.
本来不喜欢 — originally didn't like it.
Running started last year, not work.
questions.translation: I didn't use to like exercise, but since I started running last year I've become healthier and happier. Now I run half an hour every day, however busy work is. ★ What do we know about the speaker?

questions.prompt:
{只有|zhǐyǒu}{亲自|qīnzì}{去|qù}{过|guo}，{你|nǐ}{才|cái}{会|huì}{知道|zhīdào}{那个|nàge}{地方|dìfang}{有|yǒu}{多|duō}{美|měi}。{照片|zhàopiàn}{上|shang}{的|de}{风景|fēngjǐng}{虽然|suīrán}{漂亮|piàoliang}，{但是|dànshì}{跟|gēn}{真|zhēn}{的|de}{比|bǐ}{起来|qǐlái}，{还是|háishi}{差|chà}{很|hěn}{多|duō}。

★ {这|zhè}{段|duàn}{话|huà}{主要|zhǔyào}{想|xiǎng}{告诉|gàosu}{我们|wǒmen}：
notes: Taking photos isn't the point.
差很多 — photos fall far short.
It's very beautiful.
questions.translation: Only if you've been there yourself will you know how beautiful it is. The photos are pretty, but compared with the real thing they fall far short. ★ What is the main message?
